entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
?Court No. - 1
Case :- Misc. Bench No. - 13580 of 2020

Petitioner :- Al Mohammadi Foods Lucknow, Thru. Prop. Mohammad Awwaleen
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Food & Civil Supplies & Ors.

Counsel for Petitioner :- Sheikh Mohammad Ali
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pankaj Kumar Jaiswal,J.
Hon'ble Dinesh Kumar Singh,J.
1. Heard Sri Sheikh Mohammad Ali, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Additional Chief
Standing Counsel for the State respondents.
2. Petitioner has filed an application for grant of license, vide annexure no. 1, under the provisions of
the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 and the regulations made thereunder but till date his
application has not been decided by the authority concerned and, therefore, prayer has been made
to decide the same expeditiously.
3.

Learned Additional Chief Standing Counsel, has submitted that if the application of the petitioner is still pending then the same will be decided in the light of the order of this Court dated 12.5.2017 passed in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017.
Al Mohammadi Foods Lucknow, Thru. Prop. ... vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Food & ... on 27 August, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148682143/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
1 4. Considering the aforesaid, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the competent authority respondent no.3 is directed to consider and decide the application of the petitioner for registration of license, as the case may be, in accordance with law, in the light of the order dated 12.5.2017 passed by this Court in Writ Petition (M/B) No. 8293 of 2017, within a period of two months from the date of production of certified copy of this order before him by a reasoned and speaking order.
5.
With the aforesaid, writ petition is disposed of.
